from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
from math import floor


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = data.Bars

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy] if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl] if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                if spy_bar.Close > self.previous_spy_close:
                    pass
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        today_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        today_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        yesterday_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        yesterday_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

        spy_crossed_above = (
            yesterday_spy_close is not None
            and yesterday_spy_sma is not None
            and yesterday_spy_close <= yesterday_spy_sma
            and today_spy_close > today_spy_sma
        )

        spy_crossed_below = (
            yesterday_spy_close is not None
            and yesterday_spy_sma is not None
            and yesterday_spy_close >= yesterday_spy_sma
            and today_spy_close < today_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            if spy_crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        elif spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = floor(
                0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_bar.Close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if aapl_rsi_above_60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        elif self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.previous_spy_sma = today_spy_sma

class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        present = {
            symbol: data.Bars[symbol].Close
            for symbol in self.symbols
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol)
        }

        if self.spy in present:
            spy_close = present[self.spy]

            current_spy_sma = None
            spy_cross_above = False
            spy_cross_below = False

            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100
                current_sma = (sum(self.spy_closes) - self.spy_closes[0] + spy_close) / 100

                if self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                    spy_cross_above = (
                        self.previous_spy_close <= previous_sma
                        and spy_close > current_sma
                    )
                    spy_cross_below = (
                        self.previous_spy_close >= previous_sma
                        and spy_close < current_sma
                    )

                current_spy_sma = current_sma

            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if self.aapl in present:
            aapl_close = present[self.aapl]

            if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, aapl_close)

        if len(present) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = present[self.spy]
        aapl_close = present[self.aapl]

        spy_cross_above = False
        spy_cross_below = False

        if len(self.spy_closes) == 100 and self.previous_spy_close is not None:
            previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100
            current_sma = (sum(self.spy_closes) - self.spy_closes[0] + spy_close) / 100

            spy_cross_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= previous_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )
            spy_cross_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= previous_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            if spy_cross_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        elif spy_cross_above:
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)

                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        current_time = self.Time

        if data.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma.Update(current_time, spy_bar.Close)

        if data.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(current_time, aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(data.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            if data.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            return

        spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity > 0:
            if spy_crossed_below:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy)
        elif spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)

        if self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.Liquidate(self.aapl)
        elif self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash
            if available_cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / data[self.aapl].Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
